title: NEXUS: Learning Safety Constraints and Action Models for Safe and Robust Embodied Planning
abstract: arXiv:2605.09387v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) enable embodied agents to plan from naturallanguage instructions, yet their actions may be physically infeasible or hazardous. Existing neuro-symbolic learners primarily refine execution models, while formal safety methods acquire or enforce safety constraints. This separation limits the reuse of both execution corrections and safety knowledge across tasks. We present NEXUS, a modular neuro-symbolic framework that jointly maintains a PDDL domain model and an LTL safety specification. Execution failures are used to repair action schemas, whereas detected hazards are converted into reusable LTL constraints through hierarchical semantic and translation sampling with equivalence consensus. Accumulated constraints are enforced through LTL progression during symbolic search; comparing constrained and unconstrained search outcomes distinguishes physical unreachability from safety-induced refusal. translated_title: NEXUS：学习安全约束与动作模型以实现安全且稳健的具身规划
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）使具身智能体能够根据自然语言指令进行规划，但其生成的动作可能在物理上不可行或具有危险性。现有的神经符号学习方法主要致力于精炼执行模型，而形式化安全方法则侧重于获取或强制执行安全约束。这种分离限制了执行修正与安全知识在不同任务间的复用。我们提出了 NEXUS，一个模块化的神经符号框架，它联合维护一个 PDDL 领域模型和一个 LTL 安全规范。执行失败被用于修复动作模式，而检测到的危险则通过带等价共识的分层语义与转换采样被转化为可复用的 LTL 约束。累积的约束在符号搜索过程中通过 LTL 推进来强制执行；通过比较受约束与不受约束搜索的结果，可以区分物理不可达性与由安全引发的拒绝。实验在……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: NEXUS 提出一个模块化神经符号框架，通过联合维护 PDDL 领域模型与 LTL 安全规范，利用执行失败修复动作模式、并将检测到的危险转化为可复用的 LTL 安全约束，从而实现安全且稳健的具身规划。
en_tdlr: NEXUS is a modular neuro-symbolic framework that jointly maintains a PDDL domain model and an LTL safety specification, repairing action schemas from execution failures and converting detected hazards into reusable LTL constraints, enabling safe and robust embodied planning.
